title: PowerToys Kills Itself in Background
summary: Runner/tray exits in the background while Command Palette stays alive; this now overlaps the actively instrumented random-exit tracker.
next_action: Draft a duplicate-handling comment that points the reporter to the active random-exit tracker in Issue 50169.

confidence.rationale: The symptom, linked discussion, and current maintainer work line up with the existing random-exit umbrella issue.

judgment.rationale: This issue now overlaps the active random-exit investigation in Issue 50169 rather than describing a distinct product area.
evidence: The reporter says the tray/runner disappears while Command Palette continues to run.
Issue 50169 reports the same split state: PowerToys exits while Command Palette stays active.
This issue was cross-referenced from Issue 50169 after another reporter identified the same behavior.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate this report under Issue 50169 so new bug reports and preview-build results land in the active investigation thread.

issue_context.summary: The report describes PowerToys disappearing from the tray without a clear repro, while Command Palette keeps working until PowerToys is restarted.

The reporter says the tray icon disappears and tools such as Text Extractor stop responding, but Command Palette still launches.
A PowerToys diagnostic ZIP was attached in the discussion.
A second reporter commented that they have the exact same problem.
inferences: The failure is likely in the shared runner/lifecycle path rather than in one specific utility, because multiple utilities fail at once while Command Palette remains alive.
This issue appears to be another instance of the broader random-exit family already tracked in Issue 50169.
issue_context.analysis: Because the current maintainer work is happening in Issue 50169 and this thread has no narrower repro or different ownership signal, the highest-value correction is to consolidate evidence instead of opening a second design track.

comment.body: Thanks for the report and for attaching a bug report. This now looks like the same runner-exit family being actively tracked in Issue 50169, where the team is already collecting additional preview-build logging for the case where PowerToys exits but Command Palette stays alive. I would suggest consolidating new `/bugreport` captures and any preview-build retest results there so the evidence stays in one active investigation thread.
